_about: Online rooms hosted by the server. CREATE ROOM asks the directory for a room (POST /api/rooms/hosted/create), then checks the room's listing (GET /api/enet/rooms/CODE) every poll.interval_seconds, at most poll.attempts times (Godot room_state.gd HOSTED_JOIN_ATTEMPTS and HOSTED_JOIN_INTERVAL), and joins it as a guest. The account that created the room is its owner and sees the owner controls. Every player-facing line of that flow is here; {code}, {n} and {max} are filled in by the game.
